newsitem.title: USA: AT&T, Lucent when-issued stock trades Friday.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, Lucent when-issued stock trades Friday.

text.p: Trading in "when issued" shares of AT&T Corp. and its Lucent Technolgies Inc. unit will start Friday, the New York Stock Exchange said Thursday, the next stage in the spin-off of the subsidiary.
"When issued" shares, short for "when, as, and if issued," shares, refers to entities used in transactions that are conditional, because the securities they represent have not yet been issued.
The companies will finally be split on Sept. 30, although 17.6 percent of Lucent is already trading after an initial public offering in April.

Last September, AT&T said it would split up into three publicly traded companies -- a core telecommunications services company, a telecommunications equipment company, later named Lucent, and NCR Corp., a computing firm.
NCR's spin off is due to take place by the end of the year, and will be facilitated with a similar "when issued" stock.
